label: Stag or hen party
tagline: For the stag or hen party of a friend.
name: The Party Game
lidExample: For Sanne, the last night before the wedding

spaces.13: The camping trip in the rain

chance.text: The party has started. Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
The DJ calls you over to {24}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
The guest of honour wants a photo at {11}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
The music cuts out. Go to {12} or {28}, whichever is closer. If someone owns it, pay 10 times your last throw.
Your shoes hurt. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
The taxi is full. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
You win the quiz about the guest of honour.
You have a solid alibi. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You walk into the wrong pub. Go back three spaces.
The group gave you a dare and it went wrong. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
The venue charges extra for the confetti. Pay {currency}30 per {house} and {currency}120 per {hotel}.
You tell a story the guest of honour was not meant to hear. Buy a round.
The party bus leaves from {5}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
You hand out gifts to the whole group. Pay each player {currency}40.
Someone slips an envelope into your pocket.
The guest of honour wants to stand on {39}. Go there.

chest.text: The dance floor is open. Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
The guest list went round and the envelope is full.
You drop a tray of glasses.
You get your change back from the bar.
The best man sorts it out for you. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You got the whole pub to sing the favourite song. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
You find a note in your sock.
was: You find a twenty in your sock.

chest.text: You give a toast and everyone chips in {currency}10 for you.
Your speech moves everyone. The guests chip in.
The champagne is gone and you pay for the next bottle.
The DJ gives you a tip back.
The venue has to be cleaned up. Pay {currency}35 per {house} and {currency}100 per {hotel}.
A friend puts his change in your hand.
You sell your ticket for the afterparty.

houseRules: Whoever lands on {0} tells a good story about the guest of honour.
Whoever throws doubles pays the guest of honour a compliment.
Whoever goes bankrupt gets a small dare from the table and may say no.
